args.script:
#!/bin/bash

# Get the current date and generate files for the past 7 days
for i in {0..6}; do
    date=$(date -d "$i days ago" +%Y-%m-%d)
    filename="logs/log_${date}.txt"
    
    # Generate random content with random number of error entries
    for j in {1..20}; do
        # Randomly decide if this line is an error or other content
        rand=$((RANDOM % 10))
        if [ $rand -lt 3 ]; then
            # Randomly choose between "error" and "Error"
            if [ $((RANDOM % 2)) -eq 0 ]; then
                echo "error: something went wrong at line $j" >> "$filename"
            else
                echo "Error: something went wrong at line $j" >> "$filename"
            fi
        else
            echo "info: system running normally at line $j" >> "$filename"
        fi
    done
done

echo "Log files created successfully"
ls -la logs/
